title: Create print sheet
summary: {n} stickers are arranged automatically on as few pages as possible.
bleed_hint: The artwork extends beyond the cut line so no white edges show after cutting.
calibration_text: Print at “Actual size / 100 %”. The square must measure 10 × 10 mm and the line 50 mm.
scale_hint: Does your printer print slightly too large or small? Measure the line and square on the printout and enter the values.
actual_size: Important: choose “Actual size” or “100 %” in the print dialog, not “Fit to page”.
oversized: {n} design(s) are larger than the paper and were skipped.
test_page_hint: Ruler, square and label outlines on one page
test_step_actual: Print this page at “Actual size” / “100 %” – not “Fit to page”.
test_step_measure: Measure with a ruler: the line at the top must be exactly 50 mm long, the square 10 × 10 mm.
test_step_enter: Off a little? Enter the measured values in BeySkin under “{section}” and save them as a printer profile.
test_step_outlines: Hold your parts against the outlines below to check the sizes before printing a full sheet.
profiles_hint: Save the calibration for each printer and switch between them.
preview_empty: Set at least one design to a quantity above 0.
oversized_list: Larger than the paper, will be skipped: {names}
designs_hint: 0 = not printed. Hover a design to see where it lands on the sheet.
fill_page_hint: Adds copies until the last page is full – without starting a new page.
filled: {n} more sticker(s) added to fill the page.
fill_none: The last page is already full.
print_now_hint: Opens the print dialog right away. Browsers that cannot do that (Safari, Firefox, phones) open the PDF in a new tab instead.
fallback_download: The PDF could not be opened directly, so it was downloaded instead.
